{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{},"blocks":[]}
@@@ doc small
{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}
@@@ filter mediabag-entries empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function keys(value)
  local names = {}
  for key in pairs(value) do names[#names + 1] = key end
  return table.concat(names, ',')
end
local function with_files(callback)
  return P.system.with_temporary_directory('lua-wave8b', callback)
end
local function write(path, data)
  local handle = assert(io.open(path, 'wb'))
  assert(handle:write(data))
  assert(handle:close())
end
local function run(document)
local M = P.mediabag
  probe('insert and lookup', function() M.insert('z.png', nil, 'a\0b'); return M.lookup('z.png') end)
  probe('numeric arguments', function() M.insert(12, 3, 4); return M.lookup(12) end)
  probe('sorted list', function() return M.list() end)
  probe('iterator', function() local f,s,i = M.items(); return type(f), f(s,i), f(s,i) end)
  probe('snapshot', function() local f,s,i = M.items(); M.delete('12'); return f(s,i) end)
  probe('empty', function() M.empty(); return #M.list(), M.lookup('z.png') end)
  probe('M.insert()', function() return M.insert() end)
  probe('M.insert(\039x\039)', function() return M.insert('x') end)
  probe('M.insert(\039x\039, nil)', function() return M.insert('x', nil) end)
  probe('M.insert(\039x\039, {}, \039\039)', function() return M.insert('x', {}, '') end)
  probe('M.insert(false, nil, \039\039)', function() return M.insert(false, nil, '') end)
  probe('M.insert(\039x\039, nil, {})', function() return M.insert('x', nil, {}) end)
  probe('M.lookup()', function() return M.lookup() end)
  probe('M.lookup(nil)', function() return M.lookup(nil) end)
  probe('M.lookup({})', function() return M.lookup({}) end)
  probe('M.delete()', function() return M.delete() end)
  probe('M.delete(true)', function() return M.delete(true) end)
  probe('M.delete(\039missing\039)', function() return M.delete('missing') end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function keys(value)
  local names = {}
  for key in pairs(value) do names[#names + 1] = key end
  return table.concat(names, ',')
end
local function with_files(callback)
  return P.system.with_temporary_directory('lua-wave8b', callback)
end
local function write(path, data)
  local handle = assert(io.open(path, 'wb'))
  assert(handle:write(data))
  assert(handle:close())
end
local function run(document)
local M = P.mediabag
  probe('fetch file', function() return with_files(function(dir) local f=dir..'/a.txt'; write(f,'abc'); return M.fetch(f) end) end)
  probe('loaded message', function() return with_files(function(dir)
          local path=dir..'/loaded.txt'; write(path,'data')
          local logs=P.log.silence(function() M.fetch(path) end)
          return P.json.encode(logs[1]):gsub(dir:gsub('(%W)','%%%1'),'DIR')
        end) end)
  probe('write files', function() return with_files(function(dir)
          M.insert('sub/a.txt', nil, 'abc'); M.insert('../unsafe.txt', nil, 'a');
          M.write(dir)
          local f=assert(io.open(dir..'/sub/a.txt','rb')); local data=f:read('*a'); f:close()
          local safe=P.utils.sha1('a')..'.txt'
          f=assert(io.open(dir..'/'..safe,'rb')); local hashed=f:read('*a'); f:close()
          return data, hashed
        end) end)
  probe('extract message', function() return with_files(function(dir)
          local logs=P.log.silence(function() M.write(dir,'sub/a.txt') end)
          return P.json.encode(logs[1]):gsub(dir:gsub('(%W)','%%%1'),'DIR')
        end) end)
  probe('M.write()', function() return M.write() end)
  probe('M.write({})', function() return M.write({}) end)
  probe('M.write(\039.\039, {})', function() return M.write('.', {}) end)
  probe('M.write(\039.\039, \039absent\039)', function() return M.write('.', 'absent') end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end
